svg.title: CH14 M01 — common twelfths numbered audit markup
svg.desc: Baseline preview with numbered callouts corresponding one-to-one to audit findings; final revisions and retained decisions are documented in the audit.
svg.text: All fine divisions look identical, hiding the original quarter
and third boundaries promised by the brief. The brief also
promises a 22-cell result, while the art has an equation card.
Baseline markup only · Audit records targets, exact acceptance checks, and final dispositions.
